sloka: कुरु प्रणामम् धर्मात्मन् तेषाम् उद्दिश्य राघवः ।लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा प्रयतः संयत अंजलिः ॥४-१३-२५॥
transliteration: kuru praṇāmam dharmātman teṣām uddiśya rāghavaḥ ।lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā prayataḥ saṁyata aṁjaliḥ ॥4-13-25॥

translations.english: 'O rigteous Rama you and your brother Lakshmana humbly offer obeisance to them(sacred hermitage and sages Saptajana) with folded hands and meditate on them.
